title: China injecting children to raise IQ

tellings.quote:
that I got after Rogan told me intel
people told him China was injecting
their people were their kids with stuff
raise their IQ

plain: China is said to be injecting its people, its children, with something to raise their intelligence. The comedian Kurt Metzger says he got this from the podcaster Joe Rogan, who in turn said intelligence people had told him, so it reaches the show third-hand.
